\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{QuickSort}{$A,low,high$}\If{$low&lt;high$}\State $p\gets$\Call{Partition}{$A,low,high$}\State \Call{QuickSort}{$A,low,p-1$}\State \Call{QuickSort}{$A,p+1,high$}\EndIf\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
